note: Forbidden: the Access-Accept Acct-Interim-Interval winning over a locally configured value. TestRFC2869LocalAcctIntervalOverridesAccessAccept configures 40ms against an Access-Accept of 3600s and fatals if fewer than 3 interim records arrive in 2s; TestRFC2869AbsentAcctIntervalLeavesTheAccessAcceptInCharge fatals if any interim arrives with no local value, so a NAS that ignores the Access-Accept outright fails.
